repo_notes.content: MASKED is a free, open-source (MIT), self-custodial Bitcoin wallet for Chrome (Manifest V3) and Android (Capacitor). Write for two readers: people using the wallet (plain language, no jargon, task first) and developers. Public balance = taproot bc1p; Shielded balance = BIP 352 silent payments sp1. Ecash (Cashu) and the Launchpad escrow are custodial; say so where relevant. The software is experimental and unaudited. Never suggest typing a recovery phrase anywhere except the wallet. Do not describe prices, returns, airdrops or partnerships. Updates are posted by the developer on X: @ratsonchain. src/ is the source; extension/ is build output.

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: What MASKED is, who it is for, the two balances, install links, and the safety status (experimental, unaudited).

pages.title: Getting started
pages.purpose: Install, create or restore a wallet, back up the phrase, receive, send, shield, and try Signet. Base it on docs/GETTING-STARTED.md and docs/FAQ.md.

pages.title: Public and Shielded balances
pages.purpose: How silent payments (BIP 352) work in MASKED: sp1 addresses, scanning, the scan server, change, and what stays private.

pages.title: Safety model
pages.purpose: Vault encryption, auto-lock, approvals, protected coins, look-alike address warnings, refused signatures, and the known limits from SECURITY.md.

pages.title: Tokens: BRC-20, Ordinals and LEAF
pages.purpose: Minting, inscribing and sending BRC-20 / BRC2.0, the Ordinals gallery, LEAF (CRC-20).

pages.title: RGB tokens and market
pages.purpose: Holding, sending and issuing RGB tokens, the RGB balance, backups, instant listings, lots, swaps and the market. Signet and the Mainnet beta.

pages.title: Ecash
pages.purpose: Cashu ecash: top up, pay, receive, lock to an address, and why it is custodial.

pages.title: Offline send and silent airdrop
pages.purpose: Signing a payment offline and relaying it; paying many Shielded addresses in one transaction.

pages.title: window.masked provider
pages.purpose: The dApp API for website builders, UniSat compatibility, approvals, RGB and ecash methods. Based on docs/PROVIDER.md.

pages.title: Architecture
pages.purpose: Composition root (MaskedApp), services, pure modules, views and controller, provider/background, storage keys. Based on docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

pages.title: Building and testing
pages.purpose: npm run check, npm run build, reproducible builds, the RGB engine build, Android and iOS builds, the test suite.

pages.title: Contributing
pages.purpose: How to contribute code and translations, rules for wallet code, reporting bugs and security issues.
